source: 7. What does chunk overlap actually solve, and how can too much overlap hurt retrieval and generation? [Intermediate] Overlap is mainly a boundary hedge: if an important span crosses a chunk boundary, repeating some neighboring text can allow at least one chunk to contain enough of the evidence. The cost is duplication. More overlap creates more vectors or index entries, increases ingestion and storage, and can make several nearly identical chunks occupy the top-k results. That wastes context budget and can overweight repeated evidence during generation. It can also make evaluation look better at the chunk level because the same fact appears multiple times without increasing independent evidence. There is no universal percentage that is always optimal. Use overlap when your segmentation method creates harmful boundary cuts, then measure whether it actually improves evidence recall. Structure-aware segmentation, parent-child retrieval, contextualized chunks, or retrieving neighboring sections after the initial hit can sometimes preserve continuity with less duplication. The objective is sufficient evidence, not maximum token reuse.
zh: 7. 块重叠实际上解决了什么问题，过多的重叠会如何损害检索和生成？ [中级]重叠主要是一种边界对冲：如果一个重要的跨度跨越了一个块的边界，重复一些相邻的文本可以让至少一个块包含足够的证据。成本就是重复。更多的重叠会创建更多的向量或索引条目，增加摄取和存储，并且可以使几个几乎相同的块占据 top-k 结果。这会浪费上下文预算，并且可能会在生成过程中过度强调重复的证据。它还可以使评估在块级别上看起来更好，因为同一事实多次出现而无需增加独立证据。不存在始终最佳的通用百分比。当分割方法产生有害的边界切割时使用重叠，然后衡量它是否真正提高了证据召回率。结构感知分割、父子检索、上下文化块或在初始命中后检索相邻部分有时可以保持连续性并减少重复。目标是提供足够的证据，而不是最大限度地重复使用代币。
